answer: An attacker running 24 aliases hence needs 32 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in cedar, expire in walnut, and bridge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2927 identities would post 2274 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
